# freshdesk_helpdesk_settings (Data Source)

The helpdesk's language configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_helpdesk_settings" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `help_widget_languages` (Set of String) Languages the help widget is offered in.
- `id` (String) Always `freshdesk`; these settings are account-wide.
- `portal_languages` (Set of String) Languages the customer portal is offered in.
- `primary_language` (String) Default language of the helpdesk.
- `supported_languages` (Set of String) Languages agents may work in.
